stories.title: MND Local Puerto Vallarta: Floating billboards, restaurant closures and a key resignation

en.title: MND Local Puerto Vallarta: Floating billboards, restaurant closures and a key resignation
en.summary: Puerto Vallarta is experiencing multiple challenges including issues with floating billboards, declining restaurant operations, and the departure of a key official.

stories.title: Autoridades detienen en Mexicali a “El Niño”, presunto jefe de plaza del Cártel del Pacífico

en.title: Authorities arrest "El Niño" in Mexicali, alleged plaza chief of the Pacific Cartel
en.summary: Mexican authorities arrested a man identified as Ernesto Enrique "N" in Mexicali on suspicion of drug and weapons trafficking to the United States, along with another individual.

stories.title: Familiares de Carlota "N" toman posesión legal del inmueble que fue invadido en abril de 2025; "la propiedad es nuestra"

en.title: Relatives of Carlota "N" take legal possession of property that was invaded in April 2025; "the property is ours"
en.summary: Family members of Carlota obtained legal control of a property that was occupied in April 2025, during an incident in which she used a firearm resulting in two deaths and one injury.

stories.title: Subsidiaria de Lala debuta en BMV con emisión de deuda

en.title: Lala subsidiary debuts on BMV with debt issuance
en.summary: A subsidiary of Lala launched its first debt offering on the Mexican stock exchange, issuing 7,280 million pesos in bonds with approximately a 10-year maturity.

stories.title: Bloquean Circuito; exigen a IMSS insumos, alza salarial...

en.title: Block Circuito; demand IMSS supplies, salary increase...
en.summary: IMSS employees and retirees block a major road to demand a 10% salary increase, better supply of materials, and improved pension benefits.

stories.title: Hurricane Polo, having regained strength, drenches the Pacific coast and heads for Baja

en.title: Hurricane Polo, having regained strength, drenches the Pacific coast and heads for Baja
en.summary: Hurricane Polo rapidly intensified to Category 5 status and brought unprecedented rainfall to Mexico's Pacific coast while moving toward Baja California.

stories.title: Sheinbaum confirma regreso de BTS a México en 2027; anuncia plan de acción con Corea 2026-2030 y centro de cultura K-Pop

en.title: Sheinbaum confirms BTS return to Mexico in 2027; announces action plan with Korea 2026-2030 and K-Pop cultural center
en.summary: Mexican leadership confirmed BTS will perform in Mexico in 2027 and announced a bilateral action plan with Korea spanning 2026-2030, potentially including a K-Pop cultural center.

stories.title: México y Corea del Sur firman Plan 2026-2030; impulsarán comercio, tecnología y defensa

en.title: Mexico and South Korea sign 2026-2030 Plan; will promote trade, technology and defense
en.summary: Mexico and South Korea signed a bilateral plan for 2026-2030 aimed at boosting trade, technology, and defense cooperation, while also announcing a BTS concert in 2027 and a potential K-pop cultural center.

stories.title: Banxico mantiene tasa y se desmarca de la Fed; dice explícitamente que no reacciona a sus movimientos

en.title: Banxico holds rate and distances itself from the Fed; explicitly says it does not react to its movements
en.summary: Mexico's central bank maintained its interest rate at 6.5%, meeting market expectations, while stating it does not respond to Federal Reserve policy decisions.

stories.title: Abandonan en ONU discurso de Netanyahu; los llama 'cobardes'

en.title: UN delegates abandon Netanyahu speech; calls them 'cowards'
en.summary: Several United Nations delegates left when Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu took the podium to speak, and he responded by calling them cowards.

stories.title: Mantiene Banxico en 6.50% la tasa de referencia

en.title: Banxico maintains reference rate at 6.50%
en.summary: Mexico's central bank kept its reference interest rate at 6.50 percent despite the Federal Reserve's recent policy shift.

stories.title: VIDEO: Representantes abandonan Asamblea de la ONU durante discurso de Netanyahu; "si hay más cobardes, que se salgan", responde él

en.title: VIDEO: Representatives abandon UN Assembly during Netanyahu speech; 'if there are more cowards, let them leave', he responds
en.summary: UN representatives departed during Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's address at the General Assembly, and he challenged any others who disagreed to do the same.

stories.title: Ya probamos el nuevo Xiaomi 18 Pro, el teléfono viral de Xiaomi que ahora sí llegará a México

en.title: We tested the new Xiaomi 18 Pro, Xiaomi's viral phone that will now arrive in Mexico
en.summary: The Xiaomi 18 Pro features a rear display and uses latest-generation Snapdragon chips to compete with Apple. The device is coming to Mexico.

stories.title: La batalla por la IA pone a Trump y Xi del mismo lado antes de verse cara a cara

en.title: The battle for AI puts Trump and Xi on the same side before they meet face to face
en.summary: Xi Jinping is visiting Washington for an unusual state visit where artificial intelligence will be among the key topics discussed with the U.S. president.

stories.title: Actividad económica de México sorprende y crece 0.8% en julio

en.title: Mexico's economic activity surprises and grows 0.8% in July
en.summary: Mexico's economic activity index grew 0.8% monthly and 3.3% annually in July, indicating the economy sustained momentum from the previous quarter.

stories.title: Colegiaturas y gas LP aumentan la inflación en primera quincena de septiembre por arriba de lo esperado por el mercado

en.title: Tuition and LP gas increase inflation in first half of September above market expectations
en.summary: Inflation rose faster than expected in early September, driven by education costs and LP gas prices, with primary school tuition increasing 5.85% in two weeks.

stories.title: La clave de wifi que te dan en recepción es el primer paso para paralizar a toda tu empresa

en.title: The wifi password given at reception is the first step to paralyze your entire company
en.summary: Companies accumulate multiple digital certificates and credentials without proper control over their quantity, location, or expiration dates. This lack of management can cause operational interruptions, financial losses, and reputational damage.
